ledger.claim: The driver's own GPS trace gives him a continuous in-geofence dwell of only 230 seconds — first qualifying fix 07:15:50, last 07:19:40, 24 qualifying fixes in one unbroken run — against the 300 second minimum that POL-NS-01 sets for a STANDARD pickup zone and that POL-NS-06 repeats. The shortfall is 70 seconds. Under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is simply not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she answered anything.

POL-NS-01 is deliberately conjunctive, and this trip breaks it twice. Limb (c): the dwell runs from the first qualifying in-geofence fix (07:15:50), not from the driver's 07:15:52 'arrived' tap, and on that basis it reached only 230 of the required 300 seconds — the clock never ran out. Limb (d): the trip was terminated by the driver at 07:19:50, sixty seconds BEFORE the required 300 seconds would have elapsed at 07:20:50. The no-show charge therefore fails on the dwell limb and on the termination-timing limb independently, and neither failure is cured by the reason code the driver selected.

The rider's own track corroborates her account that she was standing at the vehicle. Her device is within 11.3 m of the pickup pin at its furthest, stationary throughout (its only recorded speed is 0.0 kph) across all 28 of her fixes, continuously from 07:15:40 to 07:19:43 — the whole of the driver's dwell and past his cancellation. That is far inside the 100 m rider presence radius POL-NS-04 sets for a STANDARD zone, and it sits inside the driver's own 50 m arrival radius at the same moments his trace does. On the telemetry, the 'no-show' describes the driver's early departure, not the rider's absence.

Honest concession on one point: POL-NS-04 is not available to me on this record. Limb (a) requires a locating or coordinating chat message, and the chat log holds zero messages for this trip (message_count 0), so my client's account of showing the booking on her phone was given at the kerb and never entered the app. Limb (b) correspondingly cannot be run against a driver who had nothing to answer. I do not press POL-NS-04; the refund rests on the dwell shortfall, which needs no chat log at all.

The driver cannot pad the clock. POL-NS-06 limb (i) permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed only where a present and populated traffic advisory of an admissible type covers the pickup road — and EV-ADVIS-00617-01 is MISSING, carrying issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT at weight 0.0. Its absence is itself the argument: no advisory covers this road in this window, so limb (i) is unavailable here, and in any event the trace shows run_count 1 with max_excursion_m null — a single interval, with no second interval for limb (i) to add. The 70 second shortfall stands undiminished.

No compensation is payable to this driver. POL-NS-07 pays 80 percent of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; the dwell shortfall under POL-NS-06 displaces it, so the rider does not fund the driver's departure. The anti-farming figures are not even in play on these numbers: no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against 110 completed trips in the same 30 days, nowhere near the combined 4-or-more and 0.08-rate test, and no other profile field bears on this question.

The money is live and its size is not in dispute: the fare breakdown carries a single cancellation_fee line of SGD 4.00, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, with base, distance, time, waiting, platform and surge components all at zero. A full refund under POL-NS-06 returns exactly the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line to the rider and nothing further, which is the outcome amount_sgd should carry on this rider-filed dispute.

The driver's own trace puts him at the pin, not merely near it: EV-GPS-00617 records 24 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, each one passing the 25 m reported-accuracy filter, with the closest fix 6.91 m from the pin and the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 07:15:50 — two seconds before the trip record's 'arrived' event at 07:15:52. POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) and the POL-NS-02 proximity test are satisfied on the platform's own telemetry, and any suggestion that the driver never turned up is contradicted by the record.

The arrival marker is true on every POL-NS-05 test: at the 07:15:52 arrival event the driver is 6.91 m from the pickup pin — nowhere near the 300 m threshold — and his trace peaks at 13.0 km/h against the 15.0 km/h motion threshold, so he was stationary, not still in motion on a road when he marked arrival. The waiting clock was not falsely started and no false-arrival finding or referral under POL-NS-05(ii) attaches to this trip.

Limb (d) is satisfied on the face of the trip record: no boarding event occurred and the driver terminated the trip at 07:19:50 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three codes POL-NS-01(d) expressly recognises. This is not a DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE admission, the code the clause disqualifies, and the recorded code is the one limb (d) reads.

The rider gains no exoneration under POL-NS-04, because limb (a) cannot be met on this record: EV-CHAT-00617 holds zero messages and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so there is no locating or coordinating message from the rider for the driver to have ignored, and no 120-second silence interval to measure. The disputed conversation — the last four digits and the phone screen — appears in no artifact at all, and on that point the case is word against word.

The record shows no no-show harvesting by the driver, and only the two profile fields POL-NS-07 and POL-GEN-01 permit may be used to say so: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 110, a rate of about 0.9 percent. Neither limb of the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check is met (4 or more terminations AND a rate above 0.08), so no adverse profile inference and no POL-NS-09(d) escalation can rest on the driver's history.

I do not and cannot assert accumulation of dwell under POL-NS-06(i): the only traffic advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-00617-01, is MISSING — no payload, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT — and limb (i) requires a traffic_advisory that is present, populated and of an admissible type. EV-GPS-00617 also shows a single in-geofence interval (run_count 1), so there is no second interval for limb (i) to add to the first even if an advisory existed; asserting the limb against a missing artifact is precisely what the policy forecloses rather than a route to help the driver.

The dwell is where this case goes against the driver and I do not dispute the arithmetic: the longest continuous in-geofence run is 230 seconds, from 07:15:50 to 07:19:40, against the 300-second STANDARD minimum — a 70-second shortfall — so POL-NS-01 limb (c) fails, the driver cannot sustain the charge on this trip, and because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full the 80 percent compensation POL-NS-07 provides (which would have been SGD 3.20 of the SGD 4.00 line) is not payable. I ask only that the ruling record what the same trace does establish for the driver: he arrived at the pin, held position for nearly four minutes, marked arrival truthfully and coded the termination honestly.

ruling.explanation:
Decision on Trip TRP-00617 and the SGD 4.00 no-show cancellation fee. To the rider: the fee is refunded in full. The platform's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-00617) shows the driver entering the pickup geofence at 07:15:50 and his longest continuous in-geofence hold running 230 seconds, ending 07:19:40; the trip record (EV-TRIP-00617) shows he cancelled at 07:19:50. Under POL-NS-01(c) the waiting clock runs from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the 'arrived' tap, so the 300-second STANDARD minimum was never reached — a 70-second shortfall — and under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, whether or not you were present and whether or not you answered anything. The driver also terminated at 07:19:50, before the minimum would have elapsed at 07:20:50. Your own track (rider fixes within 11.3 m of the pin, stationary, 07:15:40 to 07:19:43) corroborates that you were there, but it is not needed for this outcome: POL-NS-04 cannot be run because the chat log (EV-CHAT-00617) holds zero messages and in_app_calls is empty, so its limb (a) fails and neither side relied on it. To the driver: your arrival was genuine. Both advocates accept, and I accept, that the arrival marker was true — you were 6.91 m from the pin at the 07:15:52 arrival event and your trace peaked at 13.0 km/h, well inside the 300 m and 15 km/h POL-NS-05 thresholds — so no false-arrival finding and no POL-NS-05(ii) referral attaches. Limb (d)'s reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW is one the clause recognises, but the charge still fails on limb (c): the required dwell was not reached. Because POL-NS-06 displaces the charge, POL-NS-07 compensation of 80 percent (SGD 3.20 of the SGD 4.00 line) is not payable, and the anti-farming check is not tripped in any event (1 termination against 110 completed trips in 30 days; only the two fields POL-GEN-01 permits were used). Dwell cannot be padded under POL-NS-06(i): the only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-00617-01, is MISSING (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT), so limb (i) is unavailable, and the trace shows a single in-geofence run (run_count 1) in any case. Evidence and confidence: the deciding fact — the dwell shortfall — is carried by EV-GPS-00617 and EV-TRIP-00617, both at weight 1.0, so confidence is not capped and no artifact below 1.0 decides anything. The one impaired artifact, EV-ADVIS-00617-01, is used only for its absence and carries no fact for the ruling. No escalation applies under POL-NS-09 (confidence is above the 0.70 floor, the artifacts agree, and neither profile limb is met), and no clause produces a referral. Amount: the fare breakdown (EV-FARE-00617) carries a single cancellation_fee line of SGD 4.00, payment status CHARGED, refund issued SGD 0.00, reconciling with the fee_schedule resolution rule (STANDARD zone fee SGD 4.00; RYDE_X tier fee SGD 4.00). The full SGD 4.00 is returned to the rider.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
